simple.meaning: חוּט (chûwṭ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to string together , i.e. (figuratively) to repair.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 4:12. The surrounding contexts include kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוּט (H2338) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חוּט (chûwṭ) / H2338 is traced through Ezra 4:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.
